narrative.offerRewardText: You've recovered three of my OOX homing robots!  You've gone above and beyond what you needed to, so I will give you something special for all your help.  It is a miniature version of the very same robot that you have come to know and love, the OOX!I normally wouldn't let anyone have such a potentially lethal device, but you've been a real help.  Besides - the combat mechanisms and the homing logic on this one have been disabled.Other than that, it's an OOX by golly!

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 45 to 50, 35,550 XP in all.

quests.name: Find OOX-22/FE!
quests.objectiveText: Take the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot in a cave near Feral Scar Vale.

quests.name: Find OOX-17/TN!
quests.objectiveText: Bring the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot.

quests.name: Find OOX-09/HL!
quests.objectiveText: Take the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot at the head of the river in the Hinterlands, near Skulk Rock.

quests.name: Rescue OOX-22/FE!
quests.objectiveText: Escort OOX-22/FE to the dock along the Forgotten Coast, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

quests.name: Rescue OOX-17/TN!
quests.objectiveText: Escort OOX-17/TN to Steamwheedle Port, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

quests.name: Rescue OOX-09/HL!
quests.objectiveText: Escort OOX-09/HL to the shoreline beyond Overlook Cliff, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
